p.src: 1  Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

en: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.
u.src: 1  Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

p.src: 2  He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

en: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”
u.src: 2  He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

ja: 5:2 一キュビトは成人男性の中指の先から肘までの長さで、約46センチメートル、または18インチである。
en: 5:2 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

p.src: 3  Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

p.src: 4  I will cause it to go out,” says the LORD of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

en: 5:6 An ephah is a measure of volume of about 22 liters, 5.8 U. S. gallons, or about 2/3 of a bushel.
